ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: CLIP uses the camera to photograph and film the steps of your work instructions, and to read station QR codes.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: CLIP uses the microphone to record your voice notes and the sound of your videos, and to talk to the voice assistant.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CLIP accesses your photos and videos to add media you already took to a work instruction.
